reference_domains.label: Global Frontend Framework Reference
rules: Treat framework/tooling names as detected evidence, not as project-specific roles or boilerplate.
Do not generate static framework boilerplate unless the task explicitly asks for new files and the target rules allow implementation.
Use detected commands and selected PROJECT_SCOPE before recommending setup or migration steps.
Package imports remain external unless they resolve to concrete local project files outside dependency manifests.
guardrails: No dependency list is embedded into AI-RULES.
No package import is auto-copied as a project file.

reference_domains.label: Import Aware Project Scope Reference
rules: When Include Imports is enabled, selected files must expand to project-local import matches before prompt generation and ZIP export.
Only resolved project-tree paths may be added; external packages are not copied as imports.
Imported paths are scope references and must preserve project-relative paths in export.

reference_domains.label: Dependency Manifest Export Reference
rules: Dependency manifests are exported only when the explicit checkbox/CLI flag is active.
Only package.json, requirements.txt and requirements.json may be forced into ZIP by this feature.
Dependency lists must stay out of AI-RULES and AI-CHAT active context.

reference_domains.label: Tool-Wide Prompt Engineering Reference
rules: Prompt engineering applies across the whole tool: schema, GUI state, export scope, generated prompts and eval reports must agree.
Separate authority context, user prompt text, project evidence, constraints, output contract and validation posture.
Prefer dynamic routing from evidence over static project-specific prompt blocks.
Generated and exported artifacts must prefer output/export as the single visible output folder.

operation_roles.label: Create Vue Project Operator
rules: Create or initialize Vue project structure only when the actual task asks for creation, not during role-prompt generation.
Respect detected package manager and commands; do not invent scripts.
Prefer minimal setup and clearly separate assumptions from detected evidence.

operation_roles.label: Import Scope Operator
rules: Expand selected files with resolved local imports before generating AI-RULES/prompt scope.
Keep external packages as dependency evidence only, never as files to copy.
Document import-expanded paths in LIBRARY.scope_expansion.

operation_roles.label: Dependency Manifest Export Operator
rules: Never embed dependency lists in AI-RULES.
Only copy package.json, requirements.txt and requirements.json into ZIP when the explicit export option is enabled.
Do not copy lockfiles or installed dependency folders through this feature.

operation_roles.label: Tool-Wide Prompt Architect Operator
rules: Keep prompt engineering behavior consistent across GUI, CLI, schema, generated AI-RULES, prompts, manifest and validation checklist.
Dynamic evidence routing beats project-specific prompt blocks.
Every custom prompt wrapper must preserve user intent while adding scope, roles, weights and validation boundaries.

operation_roles.label: Frontend Component Operator
rules: Treat component work as a generic frontend component task; a framework is selected only from evidence or explicit task intent.
Search selected PROJECT_SCOPE for existing components before suggesting new files.
No static component boilerplate by default. Match existing project style when evidence exists.

hooks.label: Output/export Save Path Gate
rules: Project root and generated/export output folder are separate paths.
Generated files, prompt files, schema copies, token files, handoff notes, ZIPs and compact handoff files must prefer output/export.
ZIP export clears only stale clone/ZIP/manifest/prompt sidecars inside output/export, never the project root and never the whole generated output folder.

hooks.label: Dependency Manifest Export Gate
rules: Dependency manifests are excluded from ZIP unless explicitly enabled.
AI-RULES never embeds dependency names or requirement lines.

hooks.label: Dynamic Global Role Gate
rules: Roles must be global capabilities, not names of one user project.
Dependencies may activate references or roles, but must not create project-specific role definitions.

hooks.label: Frontend Framework Evidence Gate
rules: Use detected framework/tooling evidence as routing metadata only.
Do not create dependency-specific or project-specific roles.
Do not embed dependency inventories into AI-RULES.
Do not resolve package imports as project files.

weight_operators.label: Tool-Wide Prompt Context Operator
rules: Build prompts from authority, user intent, project scope, references, weights, output contract and validation posture.
Avoid static project-specific prompt blocks.
Keep dependency inventories out of AI-RULES active context.

weight_operators.label: Dynamic Frontend Framework Operator
rules: Use framework evidence to route decisions; do not output static boilerplate by default.
Respect detected build/lint commands and package manager.
When creating files, keep components small and match existing project structure.

weight_table.label: Frontend Framework Evidence Standard
weight_table.human_style: Use detected frontend framework evidence, but keep roles global and changes minimal.
rules: Framework evidence may activate general routing and validation posture, not static project-specific roles.
Use PROJECT_SCOPE before implementation.
Prefer existing project structure over boilerplate.
Dependency package imports never expand file scope.
